name: heat_pump_r410a_air_evaporator
title: Air-source heat pump with R410A (evaporator air side)
summary: Air-to-water heat pump on R410A with evaporator pressure drop: refrigerant flow from the condenser heat balance on the water side, evaporator air flow for a 15 K air cooling, overall COP and compressor isentropic efficiency; zeotropic temperature evaluation under the dome.

Companion CoolProp script: all main results within 4e-6 relative.
